h1: Crystal Hotel Hat Yai — A Rooftop Pool Right Next to Central Festival
intro: If you come to Hat Yai mainly to eat and shop and want a 4-star hotel you can walk across to Central Festival, Crystal Hotel Hat Yai is a name shoppers keep choosing. This hotel of around 228 rooms on Kanchanavanich Road has a rooftop swimming pool, a gym and free parking. Its spot beside the mall means meals, a movie or shopping are just minutes on foot. Rooms start from about THB 900/night, with an overall score of 8.9 from real guest reviews.

body.html: Crystal Hotel Hat Yai is a hotel of around 228 rooms on Kanchanavanich Road that opened in 2014. The reason people pick it is clear: it sits right next to Central Festival Hatyai, so you can walk across to the mall in a few minutes to eat, catch a movie or shop. The Cenfest Night Market and Hatyai Hall are right by it too, so in the evening you can head out for food without calling a ride — ideal for travelers who come to Hat Yai specifically to eat and shop.

Rooms come in several types, from the Skyline Room with a queen bed, Deluxe Twin and Smart Deluxe Twin with two single beds, up to the Deluxe King Suite. Rooms are bright and clean, with air conditioning, a minibar, fridge, flat-screen TV and a safe. Many reviews rate cleanliness as high as 9.0 and praise how well the rooms are kept, with comfortable beds. Several rooms look out over the Hat Yai skyline, a view guests like to photograph at night.
"Clean rooms, just cross the street to Central Festival, easy to head out for dinner in the evening. The rooftop pool has a lovely city view. Good value at this price."

The highlight people mention most is the rooftop swimming pool with its view over the Hat Yai skyline — great for a late-afternoon swim or photos. There's also a gym, a bar, an in-house restaurant and free parking, which is a real plus for anyone driving in from Trang, Phatthalung or Satun. Breakfast is served from 7:00–10:00 AM, and most reviews say there's a fair spread with decent flavor for the price.

To be honest, some reviews mention air conditioning in certain rooms that doesn't cool fully, plus a damp or musty smell in a few rooms. Since the building has been open since 2014, some rooms show a little wear. A few guests also note outside or next-door noise on some nights. If that worries you, ask for a higher floor or a recently refurbished room when booking, and request a room not facing the main road.

Service reviews lean positive. Many praise the friendly, helpful staff, especially at reception and with arranging transport. Being next to the mall means food and late-night safety are non-issues, since there's a steady flow of people around. The one thing to plan for is long weekends and festivals, when Hat Yai gets busy and the parking and lifts can be more crowded than usual.

In short, Crystal Hotel Hat Yai is a solid pick for travelers who value a location next to Central Festival, a rooftop pool and free parking over top-tier luxury. Its overall score of 8.9 from real Trip.com reviews shows most guests are happy with what they pay for. At around THB 900/night for a 4-star hotel within walking distance of the mall, it's good value for an eat-shop-explore trip in Hat Yai.

honestSummary: Crystal Hotel Hat Yai stands out for its location next to Central Festival, rooftop pool and free parking, ideal for travelers who come to Hat Yai to eat and shop or who drive in. It's a building that's been open since 2014, so some rooms have air-con and damp-smell issues — but for this price and location, it's a sensible pick for an eat-shop-explore trip.
honestChecks: If you're sensitive to air conditioning or musty smells — some rooms get reviews about this → ask for a higher floor or a recently refurbished room, and test the air-con when you check in.
If you need total quiet at night — the hotel sits beside a busy mall area, and some rooms catch outside noise → request a room not facing the main road when booking.
If you're here to shop and drive in yourself — the location by Central Festival and free parking are genuine advantages → book a Deluxe King Suite or Twin for more space if traveling as a group.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Crystal Hotel Hat Yai

faq.q: Where is Crystal Hotel Hat Yai and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 327 Kanchanavanich Road in Hat Yai, right next to Central Festival Hatyai. It's about a 3-minute walk to the mall, the Cenfest Night Market and Hatyai Hall. Kim Yong Market and Lee Gardens are around a 10-minute drive, and Hat Yai Airport is about 15 minutes by car.

faq.q: How much does Crystal Hotel Hat Yai cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from about THB 900/night for a Skyline Room with a queen bed. There's a Deluxe Twin around THB 1,050, a Smart Deluxe Twin around THB 1,200, and a Deluxe King Suite around THB 1,600. Prices vary by season and package, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Crystal Hotel Hat Yai best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for travelers who come to Hat Yai to eat and shop and for those driving in. The location next to Central Festival lets you walk to the mall, and there's a rooftop pool and free parking. It suits couples, families and groups of friends who want convenience in the city.

faq.q: Does Crystal Hotel Hat Yai have a pool and parking?
faq.a: Yes. There's a rooftop swimming pool with a city view, a gym, a bar, a restaurant and free parking. The rooftop pool is frequently praised in reviews for its view, while the free parking is a real plus for guests who drive in.

faq.q: Are there air-con or musty-smell issues at Crystal Hotel Hat Yai?
faq.a: Some reviews mention air conditioning in certain rooms that doesn't cool fully, plus a damp or musty smell in a few rooms. The building has been open since 2014, so it's worth asking for a higher floor or a recently refurbished room and testing the air-con at check-in.

faq.q: What is breakfast like at Crystal Hotel Hat Yai?
faq.a: Breakfast is served from 7:00–10:00 AM. Most reviews say there's a fair range of options with decent flavor for the price. Some packages include breakfast and some don't, so check when you book.
